stageMeta.title: Stateful Task Agent
headerComment: # Stage 07 — Stateful Task Agent
# L7 = L6 + Stateful Task Seams.  Every plugin from Stage 06 is still here —
# sandbox, approval, FS, shell, search, persistence, resume — plus the
# stateful-task closure:
#   dsh-user-questions   ctx.userQuestions seam (backs the plan-mode review)
#   dsh-tool-todo        todo_write tool: whole-list replacement, each call
#                        appends a durable todo/write event to the session log
#   dsh-plan-mode        plan/mode session state + exit_plan_mode tool
#   dsh-goal             ctx.goals: event-sourced same-session goal domain
#                        (durable goal/change events, CAS revisions)
#   dsh-tool-goal        get_goal / create_goal / update_goal tools + goal
#                        policy section in the system prompt
#   dsh-storage          ctx.storage hub service
#   dsh-storage-sqlite   "sqlite" storage backend (node:sqlite)
#   dsh-storage-domain   ctx.storageDomain: domain data form over the hub
#   dsh-workspace        ctx.workspaceRegistry: durable workspace records
#                        and a session index
# The architecture concept: prompt + state + tools are all plugins.  The
# todo list, the plan-mode flag, and the goal are not hardcoded in the
# agent loop — they are state seams hung on the session event log, and the
# model reads/writes them through ordinary tool calls.  Replay of the log
# reconstructs all of them.  The workspace registry is the same idea one
# level up: durable host-side state served from a storage backend, with no
# model-facing surface at all.
# The persona is frozen (byte-for-byte identical to L4/L5/L6) so the
# progression remains a single-variable experiment.
# Second L7 closure — skills + task helpers:
#   dsh-skill              ctx.skills: scope-layered skill provider registry
#   dsh-skill-filesystem   provider "filesystem": project/custom/user roots
#   dsh-tool-skill         durable <available_skills> catalog + `skill` tool
#   dsh-skill-badge        DISABLED (upstream opt-in): bundled dsh-badge skill
#   dsh-goal-round-driver  goal-mode runtime: armed goals continue as rounds
#   dsh-agent-instructions AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md chain into durable history
#   dsh-schedule           durable reminders on the session event log
#   dsh-tool-str-replace-editor  surgical literal-match edits over ctx.fs
stageMeta.driverQuestion: Fix the divide-by-zero bug in src/calculator.js. Track the work with the todo_write tool: create a list (reproduce the bug, fix it, run the tests to verify), mark each task in_progress while you work on it and completed when done.

entries.name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-user-questions
comments: # todo_write: the model replaces the WHOLE list on every call; each call
# appends a todo/write event to the session log (last-write-wins on
# replay).  allowParallelInProgress is a required deployment choice — true
# permits several in_progress tasks at once, aligned with the other

entries.name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-todo
entries.configYaml:
config:
    allowParallelInProgress: true
# plan mode: durable plan/mode session state + the always-registered
# exit_plan_mode tool.  The /plan slash command stays dormant: it only
# registers when ctx.commands is composed (@deepseek-ai/dsh-commands is
# not mounted).  The exit review asks through ctx.userQuestions; with no
# UI provider installed the review fails with a clear NO_PROVIDER error
# and the session stays in plan mode.  Plan mode is soft guidance —
# sandbox mode and approval policy enforce restrictions independently
# and never read plan state.

entries.name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-plan-mode
entries.configYaml:
config:
    section: |
      You are in plan mode. Explore and design before presenting the
      complete plan through exit_plan_mode.
# goal domain: event-sourced same-session goal state (ctx.goals).  Every
# mutation appends a durable goal/change event with the complete
# post-mutation snapshot; the session log is the only durable authority.
# defaultMaxGoalRounds caps autonomous continuation rounds (256 is the
# package default, made explicit here for the reader).

entries.name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-goal
entries.configYaml:
config:
    defaultMaxGoalRounds: 256
# goal tools: get_goal / create_goal / update_goal, plus a fixed goal
# policy section in the system prompt.  inject = [agents, goals, tools,
# systemPrompt] — all satisfied by this graph (goals comes from dsh-goal
# above).  The advertised "execution-time authority checks" are NOT the
# L6 approval gate: they are runtime checks against the AgentRegistry
# (exact live agent, running status, open turn, direct-human message in
# the current turn).  blockedAfterConsecutiveRounds sets the hard lower
# bound before the model may self-report a goal as blocked.

entries.name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-goal
entries.configYaml:
config:
    blockedAfterConsecutiveRounds: 3
# ── workspace registry + storage chain (new in L7) ───────────────────
# ctx.workspaceRegistry (inject [storageDomain, sessionPersistence]) is
# served by a three-plugin chain:
#   dsh-storage         hub service ctx.storage; backends register on it
#                       by name — no config
#   dsh-storage-sqlite  backend "sqlite": one node:sqlite DatabaseSync
#                       connection; path is required, journalMode defaults
#                       to wal.  The db file is co-located with the JSONL
#                       session logs under ./sessions (same disposable
#                       temp workspace convention as persistence root).
#   dsh-storage-domain  domain data form: opens declared domains over a
#                       named backend; backend: sqlite routes everything
#                       to the SQLite backend (routes left at default).
# The registry registers no tools and injects no prompts — it is durable
# host-side state only.
